notes.title: Demo Week 1 Update Announcement
notes.content:
[p][/p][h1]Demo Week One Update[/h1][p]The public demo has been live for over a week now. Thank you to all players who have experienced the game and provided feedback! Based on your input, we've fixed a series of issues.[/p][h2]Update Contents[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where checking the Notebook too early in the tutorial could cause errors[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where potion information wasn't recorded in the tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where some text was too long and extended outside the frame[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing enemy/research information for some late-game content[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where selecting an unopened map would cause UI errors[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where background music would be lost after undoing on several maps[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where inventory information would be cleared after undoing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where undoing could cause blank equipment to appear in equipment slots[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where using spacebar to pick up items could sometimes result in an extra action[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where animations on enemies out of the screen may freeze until they are in the screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing translations and mistranslations in the English version[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Community[/h2][p]Join our community groups to communicate with the development team and other players:[/p][p]
[b]Discord: [/b][url="https://discord.gg/Jq3va9JAyX"]https://discord.gg/Jq3va9JAyX[/url][/p][p][/p][p]In the groups you may:[/p][list][*][p]Stay updated on development progress[/p][/*][*][p]Share suggestions and feedback[/p][/*][*][p]Participate in game discussions[/p][/*][*][p]Preview new content[/p][/*][*][p]Connect with other players[/p][/*][/list][p]You can also provide feedback through Steam discussion forum.[/p][p][/p][h2]Content Preview[/h2][p]We will release detailed major content reports in future updates. As a bonus for this update announcement, we've randomly selected a late-game equipment/skill to preview (UI in the image is still being implemented and optimized):[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45323484/6cfae615e9ce653be6e092cd5f1ee610879c8eed.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for your support and feedback![/p][p][/p]

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where checking the Notebook too early in the tutorial could cause errors
Fixed a bug where potion information wasn't recorded in the tutorial
Fixed a bug where some text was too long and extended outside the frame
Fixed missing enemy/research information for some late-game content
Fixed a bug where selecting an unopened map would cause UI errors
Fixed a bug where background music would be lost after undoing on several maps
Fixed a bug where inventory information would be cleared after undoing
Fixed a bug where undoing could cause blank equipment to appear in equipment slots
Fixed a bug where using spacebar to pick up items could sometimes result in an extra action
Fixed a bug where animations on enemies out of the screen may freeze until they are in the screen
Fixed missing translations and mistranslations in the English version
